provenance: Thresholds follow common reporting practice: standardized mean difference below 0.1 for balance (Austin 2009), at least 10 events per model parameter (Peduzzi 1996), effective sample size and positivity checks for weighting (Cole & Hernan 2008). Reference rates are broad plausibility bounds for MIMIC-IV 3.1 adults, not expected values.

reference_rates.applies_when: outcome followed to the end of the index encounter
